fact: As of September 2026 neither the Cyber Security Bill nor the Computer Crimes Bill has passed the National Assembly a second time, reached the Senate or received the King's assent, and no Act has been gazetted; the 2022 bill was withdrawn and re-tabled in revised form on 22 May 2024.
title: Lesotho: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, age-gating, and reuse law
